notes.stash: Domain and CIDR payloads use specialized rule-provider behaviors; DOMAIN-REGEX and other non-specialized rules remain classical. A dedicated 我的节点 group includes every provider, while Proxy keeps regional groups visible.
notes.loon: DOMAIN-REGEX is omitted because Loon remote rules do not support it. Remote filters intentionally leave their sources unpinned so local nodes and multiple subscriptions can be considered.
notes.shadowrocket: DOMAIN-REGEX is omitted for compatibility. Service groups follow the built-in PROXY policy (the node picked on the home screen) instead of a generated Proxy group; icons are omitted because Shadowrocket has no policy-group icon parameter.
notes.surge: DOMAIN-REGEX is unsupported and omitted. Region automation uses native Smart groups over the visible 我的节点 pool; visible groups carry icon-url.
notes.qx: Native host/ip rules with explicit policies. DOMAIN-REGEX is omitted; Surge-style no-resolve is not emitted. QX uses native domain/IP matching priorities. System DNS is used by default, so no server = system entry is emitted. excluded_routes stays IPv4-only. The official complete-profile section skeleton is preserved. server_remote and all unused rewrite, script, HTTP backend, and MitM sections remain empty.
notes.egern: Native YAML rule sets preserve domain regex and no_resolve. Requires a current Egern release with urls and flatten support. Proxy reaches raw nodes through the dedicated 我的节点 subscription group.
